claim: Under incremental transfer, Amazon AppFlow transfers only the records that have been added or changed since the last successful flow run, and the first schedule-triggered flow pulls 30 days of past records at the time of the first flow run.

qualifiers.scope: first run of a schedule-triggered flow that uses incremental transfer (the guide's Incremental transfer section)

evidence.quote: When you select incremental transfer, Amazon AppFlow transfers only the records that have been added or changed since the last successful flow run.
The first schedule-triggered flow will pull 30 days of past records at the time of the first flow run.
